title: Add the "AI Generated" tag
content:
Please, like there is a tag for "Action" games, there also should be a "AI generated" tag.

I don't wanna waste my time scrolling trough a pile of ai slop """games""" on every steam event
I don't wanna see them be pumped trough my recommended or my own queue or even what people are playing feed.
I don't wanna support them at all, even with a single dollar because i did not scrolled all the way down to see that indeed it was ai sloop and i gave money to someone that did nothing at all.

Let us choose if we want or not want to be bombarded with ai sloop and black list it or not.

title: Report Bugs & Issues Here! (or Discord)
content:
If you encounter any bugs, glitches, or technical issues in the game, please let us know by commenting on this thread or posting in the bug-reports channel on Discord.
- Discord : https://discord.com/invite/uBGckF6XGE

We will continuously work to fix each issue as we confirm them, and any resolved bugs will be noted in the update announcements.

If there's anything that requires direct support rather than just reporting, please feel free to reach out in a separate post or contact us at https://nugemstudio.zendesk.com/hc

Thank you so much for your help.
